mainEntity.name: How do I extract one page from a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Click that page and press Extract. You get a one-page PDF.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the page order?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Turn on Keep the order I click and the pages are saved in the order you selected them.
